text:
Updated and re-checked `header.json`, `units-001.json` (`U05`), and `units-003.json` (`U24`, `U26`) with `plan-lint`:

- **`header.json` & `U05` (`packages/element/src/bounds.ts`)**:
  - `getArrowheadAngle` accepts `arrowheadSize: ArrowheadSize = DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE` and scales both `fullSize = getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, arrowheadSize)` and `widestSize = ARROW_ARROWHEAD_WIDEST_SIZE * arrowheadSize`, keeping the 20° angle at every preset size and widening only when shrunk by short-segment fitting; all `getArrowheadAngle` callers in `bounds.ts` pass `element.arrowheadSize`.
  - `getLinearElementRotatedBounds` (`S7`) preserves today's line-only bounds for `sm`, `md`, and `DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`, and only when `(element.arrowheadSize ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE) > DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE` extends `coords` with `getArrowheadPoints` computed on the uncached `[generateLinearElementShape(element)]` curve (handling `[cx, cy, diameter]` for `circle`/`circle_outline` and point pairs for all other arrowheads).
- **`U24` (`packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts`)**:
  - Tests that `ARROWHEAD_SIZES.xl` yields larger `getElementBounds` than the default size, that `sm`, `md`, and the default size yield identical `getElementBounds`, that short-segment fitting still caps the head on a short last segment, and that unshrunk `arrow` arrowheads keep their 20° angle at every preset size.
- **`U26` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx`)**:
  - Adds a jsdom test that restores an arrow with `arrowheadSize: 0.5` (`ARROWHEAD_SIZES.sm`), exports it to SVG via `exportScene({ type: "svg", data: { elements } })`, and asserts its arrowhead `<path>` coordinate span is smaller than the same arrow's at the default size.
